sources.articleTitle: At least 2 killed, 17 hurt in Brooklyn building collapse

headline: Brooklyn Three-Storey Building Collapse Results In Multiple Deaths
metaDescription: A three-storey building in Brooklyn has collapsed, resulting in at least two deaths and multiple injuries as emergency teams conduct a rescue operation.
aiSummaryBullets: A three-storey structure in Brooklyn suffered a collapse.
Emergency services have confirmed at least two fatalities.
Seventeen individuals sustained injuries during the event.
aiContextParagraph: A major emergency incident occurred in Brooklyn when a three-storey building collapsed, prompting a large-scale technical rescue operation. Reports from CBS News and Al Jazeera indicate that the situation necessitated the deployment of hundreds of firefighters to the site to assist in search and recovery efforts. According to the available information, at least two individuals have died as a direct result of the structural failure. Furthermore, 17 people have been reported injured following the collapse. Authorities and emergency responders remain on the scene to manage the situation and conduct necessary operations to ensure the area is secured. The incident is currently the subject of an active investigation by local officials to determine the circumstances leading to the failure of the building structure.
whyItIsViral: The event is trending due to the active emergency response and the significant number of casualties reported across multiple news outlets.
